scripts.serve:auth: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && npx nx run authorization:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.auth.js
scripts.serve:auth:ssr: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && npx nx run authorization:serve-ssr:$CLOUD_TARGET --proxy-config proxy.conf.auth.ssr.js
scripts.serve:cloud: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && npx nx run front-end:serve:$CLOUD_TARGET --proxy-config proxy.conf.front_end.js
scripts.serve:webadmin: npm run update-lang-files && npx nx run webadmin:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.webadmin.js
scripts.build: npm run cleardist && npm run lang && npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=front-end,authorization --configuration=production
scripts.build:auth: npm run cleardist && npx nx run authorization:build:production
scripts.build:auth:ssr: npm run cleardist && npx nx run authorization:server:production
scripts.build:cloud: npm run cleardist && npm run lang && npx nx run front-end:build:production
scripts.build-webadmin: npm run cleardist && npm run lang && npx nx run webadmin:build:production
scripts.bundle-report: npm run lang && npx nx run front-end:build:production --stats-json && webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/stats.json -s gzip
scripts.bundle-report:auth: npm run lang && npx nx run authorization:build:production --stats-json && webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/authorization/stats.json -s gzip
scripts.cleardist: ([ -e ./dist ] && rm -rf ./dist) && echo 'Cleared dist folder' || echo 'No Dist to clear'
scripts.test:watch: npx nx run test front-end --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.test:chrome: npx nx run test front-end --browsers Chrome --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.test:safari: npx nx run test front-end --browsers Safari --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.test:firefox: npx nx run test front-end --browsers Firefox --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.test:all: npx nx run test front-end --browsers Chrome,Safari,Firefox --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.test:components:watch: npx nx run test front-end --include=src/app/components --karma-config karma.conf.watch.js
scripts.lang: node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs && npm run handle:lang || echo 'Lang already up to date'
scripts.handle:lang: npm run update-lang && npm run fill-lang && npm run compile-lang && npm run test-lang && npm run update-lang-types && node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs update
scripts.update-lang-files: node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs && npm run handle:lang || echo 'Lang already up to date'
scripts.lang-ci-check: cp ./common/language/language_i18n.json ./src/i18n_copy.json; cp ./common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts ./src/types_copy.ts; npm run update-lang-files; cmp_i18n=$(cmp ./common/language/language_i18n.json ./src/i18n_copy.json); cmp_types=$(cmp ./common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts ./src/types_copy.ts); if [ ! -z "$cmp_i18n" ] || [ ! -z "$cmp_types" ]; then exit 1; fi
scripts.update-lang-types: quicktype ./common/language/language_i18n_static.json -o ./common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts --just-types; sed -i -e 's/string;/TranslateFuncType;/g' common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts; sed -i -e 's/string /TranslateFuncType /g' common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts; sed -i -e 's/TranslateFuncType/(params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string/g' common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts; rm -f common/language/language_i18n_static_types.ts-e
